title: Full complete-monotonicity route no-go from the Riemann-kernel super-exponential tail
statement: For every fixed 0<|y|<1/2, the canonical G024 profile H_y(q)=D_y(sqrt(q)) is not completely monotone on [0,infinity). The Riemann theta-kernel tail together with the proved G024 strong convexity L''>17 gives faster-than-every-exponential decay of H_y(q), while every nonzero completely monotone function with finite H_y(0) has a positive exponential lower envelope by the Hausdorff-Bernstein-Widder representation.

preserved_results: SOH-G024-R: global H_y''(q)>0 at the declared repository certificate level
route_effect.derived_consequence: For each fixed admissible y, at least one signed derivative inequality (-1)^m H_y^(m)(q)>=0 fails for some m>=3 and some q>=0.
